DataBINBreakout2K79Mods.strDesc: A suite of cheats and mods for the console game Breakout 2K79, including customizable uniforms, zombie mode, mecha mode, jet boots, variable gravity settings, player pets that add unique special abilities to the game, and incomprehensibly, a mode with over 100 varieties of firearms.

DataIMGRemoteControlCat.strDesc: An image of a cat sitting slouched, with paw on TV remote.

DataBINNavStationData.strDesc:
A database for use with the Polaris "Standard Navigation Console" (PSNC).

This file contains registration ID data for any vessels identified while the nav was in use.

Placing this file into any PSNC nav station will upload its contents to that console, expanding that console's list of known vessels.

DataBINPDACracker.strDesc: PDA cracking software for the Renbao "Portal" PDA.

DataBINRobotCracker.strDesc: Drone OS cracking software for Beydat construction and enforcement drones.

DataSNDJTSmoovPutItIn.strDesc: A lossless audio file of 'Put It In' by JT Smoov.

DataTXTDebitAppOutdated.strDesc: A pre-authorized debit application for an outdated bank account.

DataVIDRoboKetchup.strDesc: A video of a robot squeezing ketchup inaccurately on food.

DataBINCryptoSmall.strDesc: Loose crypto credit. Often used for tips, gifts, and untraceable transfers.

DataBINCryptoMed.strDesc: Someone cracked someone else's personal crypto wallet.

DataBINCryptoLarge.strDesc: A crypto case access PIN. People probably shouldn't leave these around. Of course, it could already be cleared out.

DataIMGCryptid02.strDesc:
A non-descript image of a hairy, dark-furred, heavily muscled man-beast with a long snout walking on two legs through woods and ruins of Michigan.

Despite nothing like woods off-Earth, some legends never die.

DataIMGXinhua02.strNameFriendly: 来得好!不然离开通过气闸!.IMG

DataVIDVlog01.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by a spacer who hopes to see all the sights in the System.

DataVIDVlog02.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by an awkward spacer who tries micro-g dance challenges and talks about self-empowerment.

DataVIDVlog03.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by a peppy spacer who shares small moments of joy in the vast emptiness.

DataVIDVlog04.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by a lonely spacer who talks about their process for creating extremely in-depth, self-insert Dalisay fanfic.

DataVIDVlog05.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by a talented spacer who sings mid-century and last-century oldies covers.

DataVIDVlog06.strDesc:
A slice-of-life video diary by a fervent disciple of famous psychic Phillip Barry.

It's mostly one big advertisement for everyone to get tested for psychic aptitude, because it could 'change your life' like it has changed theirs.

DataVIDVlog07.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by a teenaged spacer who draws dark comics and complains about being misunderstood.

DataVIDVlog08.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by a fashion-forward spacer missing some teeth but flush with romantic partners from among their large ship crew.

DataVIDVlog09.strDesc: A slice-of-life video diary by a tattoo artist who practices on Trenchers Styrofauxm and seeks fresh clients at every port.

DataVIDBlackmail.strDesc: Incriminating hidden cam footage of a saucy tryst including a local leader.

DataVIDMundane01.strDesc: Insipid training video from a few decades back about greywater handling protocols. The host speaks slowly without inflection.

DataVIDMundane03.strDesc: A series of narrated wireframe lessons covering docking scenarios and what-ifs for a variety of atypical, and usually life-threatening situations.

DataVIDMundane04.strDesc: A laboriously detailed tour of a vessel or small station interior, including the contents of every bin, rack, and drawer. Useful if taking over a solo gig for awhile.

DataVIDMundane05.strDesc: A video series of a charismatic chef demonstrating various micro-gravity cooking and food prep techniques.

DataTXTFanfic01.strDesc: A mediocre short story of extremely detailed, self-insert Dalisay fanfic, oozing with tropes and longing.

DataTXTFanfic03.strDesc: A camouflaged repository of erotica. Meticulously sorted into multiple unexpected categories.

DataTXTGame01.strDesc: A fantasy heartbreaker roleplaying game with a meticulously detailed homebrew setting and 523 pages of rules (213 of them spell entries).

DataTXTGame02.strDesc: A Select Your Own Escapade interactive gamebook featuring a thrilling interactive story of intrigue that follows Lone Star, a noir anti-hero with background and abilities defined by the reader's choices.

DataSNDSilversmythAlbum.strDesc: A torrent of the full "Gold" album by popular K-Pop group Silversmyth. A rare collectors item that could be worth money to the right buyer.

DataSNDSilversmythBloopers.strDesc: Candid audio of backstage and tour bloopers by winsome Kapyong Station-based musical group Silversmyth.

DataSNDBreathing.strDesc: White noise ASMR track of calm breathing in a sealed vacuum helmet. Occasional humming, coughs, multilingual curses, or elevated breathing punctuates the monotony.

DataSNDPercussion.strDesc: An ASMR track of close mic-ed reverberations from drumming on every concievable mundane item and material in a spacer's everyday environment. The spacer in question narrates calmly and reassuringly throughout with a beautifully sonorous voice.

DataSNDAttack.strDesc: A paranoid-sounding captain's log about a doomed expedition. The report is interrupted partway through by sounds of violence, angry voices, and ship alarms.

DataSNDAttack02.strDesc: A bridge-recording of the moment assailants breach the doors, the ensuing firefight, and the panicked cursing and somber cheering of the survivors.

DataSNDAttack03.strDesc:
A bravado-laced comms recording of a breaching team on assault of another vessel. The team's coordination is ruthless and they mock their enemies as they fall before them.

The discipline, cadence, and background heavy metal music imply a well-trained PMC or pirate crew more than any formal Naval force.

DataSNDGhostStory.strDesc: A terrified spacer describes witnessing the Mariner during an EVA spacewalk. They wonder inconclusively if its helmet contains a skull, and whether that would be worse or better than a full, unblinking human face.

DataSNDGhostStory02.strDesc: An engineer's log details a fateful swarm of undefined energy signals that intervened to prevent a pirate boarding. The speaker wonders if these are the Fireflies they've heard in spacer superstitions.

DataSNDGhostStory03.strDesc: A fast-talking spacer expounds on corporate negligence and detailed theories about various ubercorp conspiracies, ending with a long rant about vacuum- and decay-proof meat that whispers maddeningly and moves when you're not looking at it.

DataSNDNeverland.strDesc: A talk radio personality rants about how wrong it is that the whole colony of Neverland, on the dwarf planet Makemake, is be populated by children. The creepiness and questionable humanity of the Neverlanders is discussed at length without nuance, empathy, or apology.

DataSNDLovedOneVoice.strDesc: A scratchy, lo-fi voice message saved from an old-format device of a loved one wishing a warm farewell in case they don't make it.

DataSNDSavedApology.strDesc: A succinct recorded apology message by someone who gets choked up hoping for relational reconciliation.

DataSNDVoiceMemo.strDesc: A voice memo of various mundane spacer tasks requiring semi-regular notifications and frequent reference.

DataSNDRoar.strDesc: A monstrous roar and clacking of clawed footsteps, echoing off bulkheads through narrow ship or station corridors. A human whisper wonders if it's gone right before the recording ends mid-scream.

DataSNDBarbershop.strDesc: A series of old-timey barbershop quartet songs sung well but recorded poorly.

DataSNDPoetry.strDesc: Dramatic readings of poetic works of Shakespeare and other classics.

DataSNDNigerianFolkLore.strDesc: An old man telling all the stories and folklore he can remember from Old Nigeria.

DataSNDAudioWill.strDesc: The last will and testament of a seemingly well-off citizen. It's not clear if this format holds up in court.

DataSNDCorporateSecret.strDesc: A probably illicitly recorded corporate board meeting where economy-shifting changes are discussed and decided.

DataSNDConfession.strDesc: A confession to heinous crimes under intensive interrogation by private security contractors. This probably is not meant for public access.

DataSNDConfession02.strDesc: A remorseful confession to terrible crimes that is met with assurances that this would all go away.

DataSNDMundane01.strDesc: A collection of meditation and stress-relief audio tracks with chanting and electronic-world rhythms, behind a steady, guiding voice. The platitudes are nice, if naive.

DataBINOstranauts.strDesc: An illegally obtained rip of a minor hit space simulation game from the early 20s taken from a backup of a russian website. Known for its outrageous bugs and lack of 'content'. Players still rate it favorably, if a little esoteric, well into the 70s.

DataBINRobotOS01.strDesc: A drone operating system and behavior log with some anomalies in the AI.

DataBINRobotOS02.strDesc: A drone operating system and behavior log.

DataBINMundane01.strDesc:
A collection of dashboards visualizing health monitoring data for a handful of crewmembers.

Collectively, there is a sense that this crew was admittedly trying to stave off the worst effects of spacer life, though ultimately failing.

The poor sleep, negligence in exercise, and excess of drinking and smoking feel all too familiar.

DataVIDVideotape3.strDesc: A painstakingly digitised copy of the film from a VHS tape, 'Inhalants 3'.
